OnlySports Benchmark
	


	
		
		Overview
	

The OnlySports Benchmark is a novel evaluation method designed to assess sports knowledge generation capabilities of language models. It's part of the larger OnlySports project, which aims to advance domain-specific language modeling in the sports domain.

	
		
		Key Features
	


1,000 diverse sports-related prompts
Covers popular sports, major leagues, prominent athletes, and game strategies
